notes.title: Update 1.1.2 is here!
notes.notes:
Hey guys! 

We're so glad for the positive reception we've been getting. We're launching a small update to fix some things we thought should improve. Here are the main ones:

- Changed puzzle 1 in Cave 2-3 map. It was buggy and a little frustrating for a lot of players. The new one should be more stable and exciting.
- Made a couple of tweaks in battles that were still a little too difficult.
- Now the player can't pick up life healing fruits while on full health.
- Fixed a bug that rendered a save slot broken when you finished the game.

Thanks again for playing Língua!

notes.title: First patch!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi guys![/b] ːsteamhappyː

I hope you're enjoying Língua, this week has given us a lot to celebrate, your support has been awesome!

We've analyzed some streamers and close friends playing the game and decided to take the battle difficulty down a notch. To achieve this we tweaked a bit on the enemy's attack speed and shot speed, life drops and the spawns of each wave.

We hope these changes make the game more fluid, fun and inclusive, after all Língua is a game for everyone of all skill levels!

Thank you so much and see you next time!
